According to a recent Deseret News/Hinckley Institute of Politics survey.pdf " conducted by Morning Consult, just 38% of registered voters in Utah approve of the ongoing war in the Middle East while 54% oppose the war.

They also are more likely to say that they don’t approve of President Donald Trump’s handling of the war, particularly as negotiations are stalled and it appears the conflict is at a standstill.
